subject: VPC bridge deep checklist + smoke walkthrough (pre-cutover)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: VPC bridge deep checklist + smoke walkthrough (pre-cutover)

Team,

We have the cutover window for Greenfield next week (9/14–9/15). Before we proceed with traffic shift I want to run a focused "deep" smoke walkthrough on the VPC bridge and control-plane connectivity so we avoid surprises during the migration. High-level asks:

- Walk through the VPC bridge runbook line-by-line (Confluence link below).
- Execute smoke scripts against the canary private deployment (20% traffic) to validate KV cache persistence, short/long seqs, and TLS reload during rollover.
- Validate telemetry thresholds and SLO gating in Datadog and the new per-route traces.
- Confirm rollback triggers + exact timeline for a 30-minute fallback if errors exceed thresholds.

I've attached the smoke scripts and Traffic MOP. Please review the checklist in Confluence (OPS/VPC-Bridge-Runbook) and call out any missing step by EOD Friday.

Suggested timeline for the walkthrough:
- 09/10 10:00–11:30 PT — dry run with Redwood ops (internal)
- 09/11 08:00–10:00 PT — joint smoke with Greenfield SRE (live environment, read-only first)
- 09/13 18:00–19:30 PT — pre-cutover final signoff bridge (all hands)

Primary goals for the smoke: KV cache warmup, prefix caching validation, circuit-breaker behaviour when we introduce load, and telemetry retention for 48h. Attachments: vpc-bridge-smoke-scripts.tar.gz, traffic-shift-mop.pdf, postcutover-telemetry-checklist.xlsx

Questions below:
1) Can Greenfield SRE confirm a single point of contact and escalation phone for the 9/11 joint smoke?
2) Any known firewall/NAT corner cases in your on-prem fabric we should prototype against?

Thanks — I want us to be conservative here.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: VPC bridge deep checklist + smoke walkthrough (pre-cutover)

Jordan — thanks for the plan and the attachments. We can support the windows you proposed.

SRE lead for the joint smoke will be me; primary fallback pager is on-call SRE alias (sre@greenfield.com) and secondary is Hana Lee (hana.lee@greenfield.com). Phone escalation for the smoke window: +1 212 555 3344 (me) or +1 646 555 2210 (Hana).

A few notes from our side:
- Our on-prem fabric has two edge NAT devices in active-passive configuration that can cause a different public source IP on failover — we recommend running the prefix-binding test from at least two subnets.
- TLS cert reload during the bridge rollover has tripped in our last internal test if node draining is not sequenced; we'll want to confirm the graceful drain sequence in the runbook.
- We'll share a read-only copy of our pre-cutover checklist and a signed compliance attestation after internal review (greensign-docs@greenfield.com).

I'll join the 9/11 window and will follow-up with the exact SRE Zoom link and an internal runbook excerpt we depend on.

—Timothy

Subject: Re: VPC bridge deep checklist + smoke walkthrough (pre-cutover)

Thanks — a couple of concrete additions to Jordan's checklist from the telemetry and runtime side:

- Pre-smoke: generate synthetic traffic that matches Greenfield 99th percentile token/sequence lengths (script included in vpc-bridge-smoke-scripts).
- During smoke: validate KV cache hit-rate > 85% within 10 minutes of warmup and per-route p50 latency within SLO (configured in Datadog dashboard: "VPC Bridge / p50 per-route").
- Canary decision logic (to move from 20% -> 60%):
  * No 5xx spike > 0.5% over baseline for 15 minutes
  * Error budget burn rate < 1.5x for 30 minutes
  * Latency p95 within 1.25x of baseline for 30 minutes
- Rollback triggers: immediate rollback if sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 10 minutes or if KV cache show persistent cold misses (>40% miss for 20 minutes).

Attached is an annotated Traffic MOP and the postcutover telemetry checklist — I've also created a short FFmpeg snippet to show graceful TLS reload (attachment reference).

Connor — can you confirm that the KV cache priming steps in the runbook will be executed in parallel across both private clusters (east / west) to avoid a single-point cold-start?

Lauren Bishop
Principal Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Timothy Ho <timothy.ho@greenfield.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 11:02:55 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC bridge deep checklist + smoke walkthrough (pre-cutover)

Lauren — confirmed. We will run the KV priming in parallel across east/west private clusters and include short warmup sweeps for both short and long sequences to validate eviction/TTL behaviour. Notes:
- Priming will use the sample workload generator in vpc-bridge-smoke-scripts; estimate 12–14 minutes to reach warm-state per cluster.
- We'll publish a short live log (SSE) during the 9/11 joint smoke so Greenfield SRE can watch real-time cache hit-rate and per-route latencies. Link will be posted to the joint Zoom chat.

Also adding a minor ops ask: please confirm whether Greenfield needs us to rotate the client certs before the 9/11 test — if so we should schedule that for 9/10 during the dry run window.

—Connor

SG — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth before the window:

Action items:
- Greenfield (Timothy): send Zoom + escalation phone for 9/11 joint smoke (you said you would). Also please confirm cert rotation requirement by EOD 9/9.
- Redwood (Connor): run KV priming in parallel; publish SSE link during 9/11.
- Redwood (Lauren): finalise telemetry gating and upload annotated MOP (done).
- Jordan: run the dry run 9/10 10:00–11:30 PT with internal ops and update Confluence runbook with the minor sequencing notes on TLS drain.

Decision points for cutover: move to 60% if canary holds per Lauren's gating rules. Rollback plan: 30-minute fallback to previous cluster using traffic-shift-mop.pdf (steps 1–7).

I'll update the Confluence page with the times and attach the smoke output after 9/11. If anything changes on Greenfield's side, flag immediately in this thread.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.

—Jordan
